published.source: DPS report 2026-10-31 (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s; re-simmed on 2026-10-30 or 2026-10-31)

summary: Backstab on daggers with Seal Fate from Assassination.
rotation: The Combat Daggers rotation, minus Adrenaline Rush and Blade Flurry (not talented)
Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when it's down. Refresh it at 5 when it's about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Eureka! (Gnome) on cooldown while Slice and Dice has 8s+ left
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less. Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points when Slice and Dice is up, at 79+ energy, or with under 6s left. Spend leftover points in the last 3s
Backstab within 0.25s after a main-hand swing, or at 100 energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Improved Sinister Strike 2 adds no DPS.
Murder does nothing on the generic boss, so its points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Backstab and Eviscerate stop at rank VIII and Deadly Poison at IV. The books would add 13 to 18 DPS.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't counted. They would add about 8 and 6 DPS.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. The flask gives its full bonus only there.
10% hit (10 hit rating each on the wrist and second ring). Hit past the 8% cap still helps white hits, so 10% beats 8% by 0.4 to 1.9 DPS.
notes: Spec family set to Assassination (30 Assassination points); the PR frames it as a variant of Combat Daggers and it uses the rogue_combat mksettings setup and the Combat Daggers APL. Gnome since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick, with the level60_combat_daggers rotation regenerated with eurekaCp=0 (tools/rotopt/rogue_presets.sh), which was the Gnome race override; the same rotation is 0.0 for any other race (725.3 as Orc, unchanged). Was Orc. Undead since the second 2026-10-27 race re-pick (after dev notes post 8: Orc Blood Fury 2 min, Troll Berserking 15 s, Undead Touch of the Grave 15 s; the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Gnome. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
